before: Admitted font bytes could exceed the fixed shaping execution ceiling without a host option to select a bounded execution policy.
after: Hosts can explicitly select a per-face execution ceiling. Default limits and canonical document data remain unchanged; producer identity includes the selected refusal policy.
reason: The option changes local shaping admission, not canonical OOXML, tree operations or room data. Peers seeking the same geometry must supply the same host font and execution configuration.
